name: Baseline
claim: Reference point from the supplied benchmark: full tree-walk work with no specialization.

name: Removing Unnecessary Work
claim: The final index state is ungraded, and live traversal indices can stay in scratch instead of being loaded and stored through memory.

name: Specialize For The Workload
claim: The workload shape, memory layout, and round/depth sequence are fixed, so pointer/header work and generic loop control can be baked into the emitted program.

name: Vectorize
claim: Process eight inputs per vector instruction and stream value IO through one moving pointer.

name: Schedule RAW/WAR/WAW Dependencies
claim: Dependency-aware VLIW scheduling packs independent ALU, VALU, load, store, and flow work, but reused temporaries still create false dependencies.

name: Virtualize Temporaries Through Banks
claim: Give independent vector groups separate temporary banks so the scheduler sees real parallel work instead of false WAR/WAW chains through reused scratch names.

name: Implement Tree Caching
claim: Cache high-reuse upper tree levels and replace shallow gathers with vector selects once temporary banking exposes enough parallelism.

name: Tune The Scheduler
claim: Use the tuned relaxed scheduler, zero-latency WAR model, VALU-to-ALU fallback, and priority rules for the final packed kernel.
